subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should npm `alpha` remain the sole packaged early-access channel with `dev` defined as git-only, or should OpenClaw operate a separate npm `dev` snapshot channel?
rationale: The choice defines trusted publishing, package provenance, versioning, and user-support contracts; source inspection cannot establish the intended permanent policy.

options.title: Standardize alpha plus git dev
options.body: Keep npm `alpha` for packaged prereleases, define `dev` as the moving `main` checkout, and remove optional npm `dev` wording.

options.title: Operate npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add distinct snapshot versioning, trusted triggers, provenance, retention, verification, and user-facing semantics alongside `alpha`.

recommendation.title: Standardize alpha plus git dev
recommendation.body: Keep npm `alpha` for packaged prereleases, define `dev` as the moving `main` checkout, and remove optional npm `dev` wording.
